name: Multi-Vector HID + Network
description: The Bash Bunny combines HID attack capability with network interface emulation and mass storage in a single device. It can simultaneously emulate a keyboard, Ethernet adapter, and USB drive, enabling complex multi-stage payloads that exfiltrate data, capture credentials, and establish network persistence in a single insertion. It is the tool of choice when a single unattended workstation access window must accomplish multiple objectives.

blue.det: Endpoint DLP alert on HID device; SIEM alert on new USB device; network monitoring shows new unknown device; EDR behavioral detection for keystroke injection combined with network activity.
blue.cm: USB device allowlisting; NAC preventing unauthorized network access; EDR with behavioral detection; network segmentation; workstation auto-lock; port blockers on unattended workstations.
